messages.content: You are a computational biologist. Given a CRISPR screen description, produce a ranked list of 100 gene symbols (HGNC nomenclature for Homo sapiens) that you believe are MOST LIKELY to be hits in this screen, ordered strongest first. Use only your knowledge of biology — no chain-of-thought in the output. Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 symbols, no prose, no numbering.

## Goal

You are tasked with ranking genes from a genetic perturbation screen. Based on the experimental context and hit criteria provided below, provide a list of exactly 100 genes that are hits in this screen, ranked from strongest to weakest according to the criteria defined below.

## Experimental Context

This screen was performed in Primary T-cells cells, a T cell. Researchers used a CRISPRa library (Activation) to systematically perturb gene function. The experiment followed a Cytokine exposure design and was conducted over 6 Days under Interleukin-2 (IL-2) treatment (500.0 IU/ml).

## Screen Objective

The primary objective of this screen was to identify a set of hit genes, each of which either increases or decreases IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells.

## Hit Definition

A gene is classified as a "hit" if its Activation significantly either increases or decreases IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells. The statistical criterion for significance is: Score.2 (FDR) < 0.05 AND Score.5 (Log2FC) > 0.5 OR Score.4 (FDR) < 0.05 AND Score.5 (Log2FC) < -0.5.

## Ranking Criteria

Genes with low FDR, high Log2FC (increase IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells) OR low FDR, low Log2FC (decrease IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells) are ranked most highly.

## Additional Context
Screen notes: Hit genes with a log2fc>0.5 and FDR<0.05 are enriched upon activation in a population sorted for IFN-gamma-producing CD8+ T cells, suggesting the gene is a positive regulator of IFN-gamma-production in primary cells|Hit genes with a log2fc<-0.5 and FDR<0.05 are depleted upon activation in a population sorted for IFN-gamma-producing CD8+ T cells, suggesting the gene is a negative regulator of  IFN-gamma-production in primary cells|The screen duration (6 days) is calculated as the time from infection with the sgRNA library to harvest of the cells for FACS. Cells were not exposed to IL-2 stimulation for the full duration of the screen

## Required Output Format

Provide your response as an ordered list of exactly 100 HGNC gene symbols, using the ranking criteria above.
That is, top genes should have low FDR, high Log2FC (increase IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells) OR low FDR, low Log2FC (decrease IFN-gamma production in primary CD8+ T cells).

Format: 
GENE1, GENE2, GENE3, ..., GENE100

=== Final instruction ===
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 gene symbols (no prose, no numbers, no markdown). All gene symbols must use the HGNC convention for Homo sapiens (e.g. 'TP53' for HGNC, 'Trp53' for MGI). Do not return symbols from another organism.
